verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a 'Filters & Rules' feature, which covers the rule-based routing half of the story only by title. Nothing shows assigning conversations to teammates, shared ownership, or routing mail to specific team members, so the core team-ownership element is unevidenced. Missing for 10: conversation assignment to teammates, explicit ownership/shared-inbox tracking, documented details of rule-based routing to team members, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
